rule.description: SOC AI bridge event.
SOC AI: connection test received.
SOC AI flow: $(model_interpretation). Maximum non-BENIGN score=$(score_max), threshold=$(attack_score_threshold), $(source_ip) to $(target_ip), flows=$(flow_count). Attack is unconfirmed.
SOC AI correlation: possible reconnaissance from $(source_ip) to $(target_ip), priority=$(risk_score).
SOC AI correlation: repeated password failures from $(source_ip) for $(username) on $(target_host), priority=$(risk_score).
SOC AI correlation: successful login after repeated password failures from $(source_ip) for $(username) on $(target_host); investigate. Priority=$(risk_score), chain=$(attack_chain).
SOC AI HTTP evidence: possible SQL injection from $(source_ip) to $(target_host). Exploitation success is not proven.
SOC AI flow observation: $(predicted_label), decision=$(decision), $(source_ip) to $(target_ip).
SOC AI auth observation: $(activity_type), user=$(username), source=$(source_ip), host=$(target_host).
SOC AI sensor evidence: $(signature), $(source_ip) to $(target_ip), priority=$(risk_score).
SOC AI HTTP observation: $(http_method), status=$(http_status), requests=$(request_count), $(source_ip) to $(target_ip).
SOC AI sensor quality: $(source_container), truncated=$(ipv4_truncated_packets), stream gaps=$(tcp_reassembly_gaps), drops=$(kernel_drops).
SOC chain or candidate: $(chain_id), stages=$(attack_chain_stage_count), risk=$(risk_score), $(source_ip) to $(target_ip).
SOC chain evidence: $(chain_id), branch=$(branch_id), stage=$(stage_name).
SOC high-priority attack chain: $(chain_id), risk=$(risk_score). Correlated hypothesis; investigate.
SOC sensor: SQL injection payload indicator from $(source_ip) to $(target_ip). Attempt observed; exploitation success is not proven.
SOC HTTP pressure: $(source_ip) to $(target_ip)$(http_route), $(request_count) requests/$(window_seconds)s. Service degradation is not established.

SOC possible HTTP DoS: $(source_ip) to $(target_ip)$(http_route), requests=$(request_count), 5xx=$(server_5xx_count), p95=$(burst_p95_us)us. Same-route baseline and degradation observed; causality and outage are unconfirmed.
SOC possible SYN flood: $(source_ip) to $(target_ip):$(target_port), $(syn_connection_count) unique SYN flows/$(window_seconds)s. Half-open connections and service degradation are unconfirmed.

SOC CRITICAL reverse-shell behavior: shell PID $(pid), UID $(effective_uid) on $(target_host), outbound socket to $(peer_ip):$(peer_port). Shell I/O and outgoing SYN verified. SSH association=$(ssh_session_link_method). Authorization and privilege escalation are unconfirmed.
SOC SSH service contact: $(source_ip) to $(target_ip):22. SYN observed; scanner, intent and attack are unknown. No completed-flow wait.
SOC CRITICAL chain: $(chain_id), verified reverse-shell behavior, stages=$(attack_chain_stage_count), $(source_ip) to $(target_ip). Priority is operational; unauthorized compromise is unconfirmed.
SOC file observation: $(artifact_path) on $(target_host), SHA256=$(artifact_sha256). File appeared or changed; transport, maliciousness and actor are unconfirmed.
SOC script interpreter observed: $(executable), PID $(pid), script=$(artifact_path), owner=$(username), host=$(target_host). Script intent is unconfirmed.
SOC crontab change: $(artifact_path) on $(target_host). Investigate scheduling changes; persistence and command execution are unconfirmed.
